NEW Skechers Hands Free Slip-ins: Glide-Step. Designed for your perfect fit.

Discover Hands Free Comfort

Discover the perfect balance of comfort and style. The Skechers Glide-Step® collection is designed for those who move, feeling a difference from step one. Whether you’re hitting the gym or hitting the shops, our signature geometric midsole technology turns every step into natural momentum.

Experience the ultimate comfort technology of Skechers Hands Free Slip-ins®. No bending, no tugging, and no laces, just steps in and get moving.

Find your perfect pair today at Skechers! Learn more at skechers.com.au
